integrity: The proof reduces generalized commutator fibers to one trace hyperplane using the nondegenerate trace pairing and the exact centralizer of a nonscalar two-by-two matrix. A standalone checker directly enumerates graph degrees and the commutator-fiber criterion over four finite fields, including a nonprime field.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the complete degree multiset, not the full graph isomorphism type for different nonzero traceless parameters.
The two-degree collapse relies on every nonscalar two-by-two matrix having a two-dimensional centralizer; larger matrix sizes require a separate similarity-type analysis.
Trace-duality for the adjoint map is standard linear algebra; the new content is the exact generalized-centralizer count and resulting graph distribution.
title: Degree distribution of prescribed-commutator graphs of two-by-two matrix rings
